# superset_database_permissions_sync (Resource)

Makes Superset 6 refresh the permissions of the catalogs and schemas of a database connection, as the *Sync permissions* action of the connection does, so roles can be granted `catalog_access` and `schema_access` on what the source gained. The sync runs when the resource is created and again whenever `database_id` or `triggers` change; it is not undone when the resource is destroyed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Sync the catalog and schema permissions of a connection. Bump the version whenever the
# source gains schemas, so the roles can be granted access to them.
resource "superset_database_permissions_sync" "warehouse" {
  database_id = superset_database.warehouse.id
  triggers = {
    version = "2"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database_id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the database connection to sync.

### Optional

- `triggers` (Map of String) Arbitrary values whose change runs the sync again, for example the list of schemas of the source.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the database connection.
